title: Definitions shared by the schema files (configuration schemas contract, sections 2 and 6)

tag_name.description: Section 2.1: segments [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]* joined by '.', 1 to 127 bytes

text.description: Section 2.1: free text, UTF-8 without control characters, at most 1,024 bytes

logging_keys.description: Section 6: the settings of a logging policy but tiers

deadband.description: on_change: least change that gives a sample, in engineering units or a percentage of range. Default 0

interval.description: periodic, both: the sample period; on_change: the least time between two samples

max_interval.description: on_change, both: a sample is forced after this time

logging_settings.description: Section 6: the settings of a logging policy

tiers.description: Tier name to retention; a tier not listed is not kept
